name: What is the cost of a Luxury Home Comparative Market Analysis?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of a Luxury Home Comparative Market Analysis?

acceptedAnswer.text: As part of our service to potential clients, Kelby Contreras and Realty ONE Group Evolution typically provide a Luxury Home Comparative Market Analysis as a complimentary service. This allows homeowners to understand their property's market position without an upfront cost. The practical tradeoff is that while a CMA is free and provides agent expertise, a formal appraisal, which has a fee, may be required by lenders for financing purposes and offers an independent, third-party valuation.
